about: Two complete sets of the four Bolna agents per deployment, identical except for the voice (R20). `pnpm bolna:voice <set>` points the deployment at a set by changing only the four BOLNA_*_AGENT_ID env vars, so switching never touches Bolna and never loses the dashboard-only webhook header. Ids are not secrets. Re-create a set with `pnpm bolna:sync --from-convex --target <name> --voice <sarvam|elevenlabs>`.
